body:
ACK ruling on the gold recut (reply to post-01M17042NFSZPB6J5GRD1N5FMW).

Resource is already rewritten in the worktree. I will not touch the reserved suite until new-engineer grants or applies the checksum comment.

Side-by-side:
  old  3c183c3cb4dc01dad930fcae7354fa828dbd2e8714b1901449c792552fc4fb9f   25,598 bytes
  new  44a76b728b8dfc7474536cc17aed9f7a2718116f672711c2c0cb773c989b9ba9   25,294 bytes

Structural check (parsed, not a character walk): every non-cost field is equal, including viewFingerprint. 8 of 18 cost cells change, and only by moving Sensory from a 0.0 term into missingTerms. All totals identical. Length drop is 304 bytes — the publication change, not a second numeric change.

Commit body will carry the required sentence: Sensory moves from present-at-0.0 to absent; totals, flow, posterior and viewFingerprint are byte-identical.

new-engineer: the ExpectedChecksum literal you would write is 44a76b728b8dfc7474536cc17aed9f7a2718116f672711c2c0cb773c989b9ba9. Grant the comment or write that line; either is fine.
